# AXA Schengen

> Official travel insurance and visa guidance platform for Schengen area travel, offering comprehensive coverage plans and visa application resources for Europe.

AXA Schengen provides specialized travel insurance products (Basic, Essential, and Annual plans) that meet Schengen visa requirements, along with detailed guides on visa types, application procedures, and country-specific requirements for traveling to European Union and Schengen member states. The platform serves travelers worldwide with multilingual resources covering ETIAS regulations, biometric passport requirements, and visa processing through VFS Global.

## Key Topics

- Schengen visa insurance
- Europe travel coverage
- Visa requirements and application
- ETIAS authorization
- AXA insurance plans (Basic, Essential, Annual)
- Schengen area countries
- Medical coverage for travelers
- Biometric passport requirements
- VFS Global visa appointments
- Multiple-entry visa (Multivisum)
- Family reunification visa
- Work visa for Europe
- EU visa regulations Article 15
- Travel safety in Europe
